clues: This east coast city sits where the Passaic River meets a bay. It forms part of the great New York city area, in New Jersey.
This city sits right on a freeze line that splits two weather zones. That line runs close to the big turnpike that cuts past the town.
This place was settled in 1666 by Puritan folks from New Haven. It is one of the oldest cities in its whole land.
Branch Brook Park holds the largest set of fine cherry trees in the land. The park is the oldest county park in its whole land.
Its airport was the first city airport for trade flights in its whole land. Now it is one of the most busy airports in that land.
